question: According of Census 2011, what was the percentage of the total migrants from Nepal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**15.1%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **2011 Indian census, there are 571,721 Nepalis living in India **while the figure in 2001 was 596,696.
 
• This is** equal to about 15.1% of the total migrants.**__
 
• The number from **2001, at 589,042,** is somewhat similar to the Indian census, but in 2011 there is a significant variance, with the Nepali census showing **720,892 living in India.**
 
• According to the Census 2011, in India, the percentage of people (approximately) considered to be migrants (internal), now settled in a place different from their previous **residence is 37 Percent.**
 
• Uttar Pradesh and Bihar are** responsible for most migrants.**
 
• According to the 2011 Census, **20.9 million people migrated outside of two states.**
 
• 45.36 crore Indians in India are migrants, who are now settled in a place different from their previous residence.
